text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU runtime OOM spike on cluster-psi-4 in us-west-2. 80% of requests failing. paging oncall
Maria Chen: ack, taking it
Jonah Patel: I have the pager, pulling logs now
Priyanka Rao: quick look shows abrupt growth in GPU resident on replica r-42 — KV cache + big batch tail visible in traces
Asa Green: which customers are seeing failures?
Customer Success Bot: Impacted: acme-inc (prod), luma-ai (prod). 5xxs up ~5-6x, CS notified.
Samir Iqbal: doing a quick nvidia-smi/dmesg dump, will paste shortly
Jonah Patel: logs dump ->
```sh
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,memory.used,memory.total --format=csv
index, name, memory.used [MiB], memory.total [MiB]
0, A100-40GB, 39400 MiB, 40536 MiB
1, A100-40GB, 39510 MiB, 40536 MiB
```
Maria Chen: runtime metrics: KV cache size ~38GB on r-42, allocator shows high external fragmentation in recent GC logs
Priyanka Rao: hypothesis list: 1) KV-cache growth + fragmentation, 2) long-tail large-batches coalescing, 3) GPU allocator fragmentation -> inability to satisfy new large allocations -> OOM
Asa Green: mitigation options — (A) cap max batch to 2048 tokens, (B) force KV eviction/compaction on the node, (C) restart the heavy replica, (D) fall back routed traffic to smaller model variant
Jonah Patel: applying option (A) now — updating hosted-routing policy to cap per-request batch to 2048 for model redwood/gpt-medium-v1
Ops Bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.runbooks/oom-gpu — Recommended live steps: cap-batch, evict-kv, controlled restart, escalate to infra if kernel pagefaults persist
Maria Chen: initiating eviction sweep on r-42 (evict threshold 0.6 -> 0.4)
Samir Iqbal: scheduling a graceful restart of r-42 if eviction doesn't bring resident memory down in 5m
Priyanka Rao: collecting perf/NVTX traces -> uploading s3://redwood-ops/incident/2370001234/trace.zip
Jonah Patel: add any logs to that S3 path. common commands we used:
```bash
# collect runtime logs for last 10m
sudo journalctl -u redwood-runtime --since '10 minutes ago' > /tmp/runtime.log
# nvml memory snapshot
python -c "import pynvml; pynvml.nvmlInit(); print(pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo(pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex(0)))"
```
Ops Bot: Customer impact note: 5xx rate rose from 0.2% -> 6.1% between 15:32-15:48 UTC. Mitigation window started 15:50 UTC.
Maria Chen: eviction reduced resident memory by ~4GB on r-42; 5xx rate dropping to ~1.5% now
Asa Green: hold monitoring — if 5xx >2% for 10m we perform restart
Priyanka Rao: uploaded hypothesis matrix to S3: [KV-cache fragmentation, batch tail causing large contiguous allocations, kernel allocator fragmentation, possible mem leak in quantized path]
Jonah Patel: owners: Maria (eviction & timeline), Priyanka (trace analysis), Samir (restart & infra ops), Asa (customer comms)
Maria Chen: timeline CSV uploaded -> s3://redwood-ops/incident/2370001234/timeline.csv. Will consolidate minute-by-minute and append logs
Samir Iqbal: performing graceful drain and restart of r-42 now — ETA ~2m
Maria Chen: post-eviction and restart snapshot: GPU0 used ~12GB, system looks stable on that replica
Priyanka Rao: capturing a sample offending request for repro:
```json
{"req_id":"rq_8a3f","batch_size":5120,"model":"gpt-medium-v1","tokens":9200}
```
Jonah Patel: note — internal batch job sent a huge aggregated request that bypassed per-request token guard. Need permanent guard in ingestion layer
Asa Green: CS update sent to acme-inc + luma-ai: short note, mitigation steps, ETA for RCA
Ops Bot: Action items for RCA: (1) Maria to produce minute-level timeline and attach logs; (2) Priyanka to correlate NVTX traces with allocation spikes and KV eviction events; (3) Jonah to reproduce locally with synthetic large-batch tail; (4) Samir to investigate allocator metrics and propose safer eviction thresholds; (5) infra to consider kernel allocator flags if fragmentation persists. Owners assigned above.
Maria Chen: I'll post consolidated timeline + initial RCA notes within 30m. Leaving thread for postmortem capture.
Jonah Patel: marking incident SEV2, adding to incidents tracker, will start postmortem draft after stabilization
Incident Bot: Incident severity set to SEV2. Postmortem requested within 72 hours.
Maria Chen: switching to monitoring mode, keep alerts in case of regression. Thanks all — close live mitigation unless we see new spike.
